vulnerable_site.dangerous_operation: in.readUnsignedInt() Vendor-Id read and in.readBytes(data) buffer copy driven by the untrusted AVP 'avp-length' field

candidates.ie_field: AVP header avp-length (3-byte length) + V (vendor) flag
candidates.data_flow: Received Diameter frame bytes are wrapped in a ByteBuf and passed to decode(). The decoder reads each AVP's 3-byte 'avp-length' (readUnsignedMedium) and validates it only with 'avpLength < AVP_HEADER_LENGTH(8)' plus 'offset+avpLength <= length'. When the V (vendor) bit is set the AVP header is actually 12 bytes, but the decoder unconditionally reads a 4-byte Vendor-Id (readUnsignedInt) and computes dataLength = avpLength - 12 (clamped to >=0). An AVP with vendor bit set and avp-length in [8..11] therefore reads 12 bytes while advancing offset by only 8 (pad), a +4-byte over-read per such AVP that accumulates across a chain of malformed vendor AVPs and, for a trailing AVP whose declared message length equals the buffer, reads past the Diameter message 'length' and out of the underlying buffer.
candidates.missing_validation: Syntactic length validation is incomplete: 'avp-length' is validated against the 8-byte base AVP header size but not against the 12-byte header size required when the V (vendor) flag is set (avpLength >= AVP_HEADER_LENGTH + 4), before the Vendor-Id read and data-length computation are performed.
